source: That's normal, but please listen.\nWe only have a few moments before Ulric notices we're not there.\nThe Seer is special. You wield spirits to induce prophetic visions.
target: 这很正常，但请听我说。\n我们只有一小会儿，很快乌尔里克就会发现我们没跟上。\n先知很特别。你御使灵，以此引出预言的幻象。

source: That's normal, but please listen.\nWe only have a few moments before Ulric notices we're not there.\nThe Seeress is special. You wield spirits to induce prophetic visions.
target: 这很正常，但请听我说。\n我们只有一小会儿，很快乌尔里克就会发现我们没跟上。\n先知很特别。你御使灵，以此引出预言的幻象。

source: Spirits, please forgive my misdeeds.\nI acted only to protect those under my watch.
target: 灵啊，请宽恕我的罪过。\n我这么做，只是为了保护受我守护的人。

source: Ulric cares about the spirits? For some reason, I didn't expect that.{w}\nBut before I can think about this further, something happens.{w}\nCatching Valessa and I off guard, we're in complete disbelief.
target: 乌尔里克竟然在意灵？不知为何，我没想到会这样。{w}\n可还没等我细想，意外就发生了。{w}\n我和瓦莱莎猝不及防，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

source: Only those who've mastered the spirits could do this.\nI'm afraid this is much larger than we thought.
target: 只有掌控了灵的人才能做到这种事。\n恐怕这远比我们想象的要严重得多。

source: But that can't be true.\nThe spirits are pure, they {i}aid{/i} us.
target: 但这不可能。\n灵是纯洁的，它们{i}帮助{/i}我们。

source: Gold and White — The Triumvirate's Standard.\nI would have never made such a deduction, but...\nOnly they could wield the spirits in this fashion.
target: 金色与白色——三人执政团的旗号。\n我本绝不会做出这样的推断，可是……\n只有他们才能以这种方式御使灵。

source: Valinorth... The Blade of Exodus...\nThere must be something the spirits aren't telling us.\nSomething we could use to take down The Triumvirate.
target: 瓦利诺斯……放逐之刃……\n灵一定还有什么没告诉我们。\n某种我们能用来了结三人执政团的东西。

source: I'm aware of their culture.\nBut their Seers use spirits, not a blade.\nDo you think it will be that easy?
target: 我对他们的文化有所了解。\n但他们的先知用的是灵，不是剑。\n你觉得会那么容易吗？

source: There's entire books written on this subject, you know.\nBut no one must know when they're in a vision.\nIt could screw up what the spirits want to show us.
target: 你知道吗，关于这个主题写了好几本书。\n但身处幻象中时，绝不能让旁人知道。\n那会搅乱灵想让我们看到的东西。

source: As long as any other dream, I guess.\nOr maybe when the spirits decide you've seen enough.\nThat's one of the things we don't really know.
target: 我猜，和寻常的梦一样长吧。\n或者，也许直到灵认为你看够了为止。\n这正是我们并不真正了解的事情之一。

source: Well, I guess we'll have to disagree on that!\nThere's nothing more pure than the spirits.\nThis gift is a truly beautiful thing.
target: 好吧，看来这点上我们只能保留分歧了！\n没有什么比灵更纯净。\n这份恩赐真是美好至极。

source: Yeah, I agree!\nThere's nothing more pure than the spirits.\nWithout the visions, we'd have died out ages ago.
target: 是啊，我同意！\n没有什么比灵更纯净。\n没有这些幻象，我们早就灭绝了。

source: But the Elder chose me, and like it or not, here I am.\nI guess I'm just blessed that I actually {i}do{/i} like this arrangement.\nIn the end, the spirits really were looking down on me.
target: 但长老选中了我，不管愿不愿意，我就站在这里。\n我只能庆幸自己{i}确实{/i}喜欢这样的安排。\n到头来，灵真的眷顾了我。

source: No one really knows why you remained untouched for so long.\nBut the theory is that they don't want to anger the spirits.\nYou know, because of all that spiritual energy residing here.
target: 没人真正知道你们为何长久以来未受侵扰。\n但有种说法是，他们不想触怒灵。\n你懂的，因为这里汇聚着那么多灵力。

source: It's not like anything I've seen before.\nSo in tune with the spirits, you let them govern you.\nThe rest of Alestia has history in their own hands.
target: 这跟我见过的任何地方都不一样。\n你们与灵如此契合，任由其主宰自己。\n而阿莱斯蒂亚的其他地方，历史都握在自己手中。

source: Not that it's a bad thing, of course.\nIt's just different from the rest of the world.\nFrom what I've seen, the spirits have a good grasp on things.
target: 当然，这并不是坏事。\n只是和世界其他地方不同罢了。\n依我所见，灵对事情把握得很好。

source: It's not that they don't care for spirits.\nActually, it's more like they don't know anything else.\nThey've lived their entire lives in areas devoid of spiritual energy.
target: 并不是他们不在乎灵。\n其实，更像是他们对别的全然不知。\n他们一辈子都生活在毫无灵力的地方。

source: I was taught that they're tears from the spirit realm.\nYou know, the spirits crying out. But I don't know {i}why{/i}.\nPerhaps our parents were reaching out to us...?
target: 我听说它们是灵界流下的眼泪。\n就是灵在哭喊。可我不知道{i}为什么{/i}。\n也许是我们父母在试着联系我们……？

source: You're joking, right...?\nI think the spirits themselves have chosen you.\nIn my mind — there's no greater honor than that.
target: 你在开玩笑吧……？\n我认为是灵亲自选择了你。\n在我看来——没有比这更高的荣耀了。

source: As soon as you learn to use it, we'll be good to go.\nI have no doubt in my mind that it's strong enough.\nYou were chosen by the spirits for this destiny.
target: 等你学会使用它，我们就能行动了。\n我毫不怀疑它的力量足够强大。\n你是被灵选中来承担这份命运的。

source: If the spirits can move power from the land, to an individual?\nWell, there's no reason to believe that the reverse isn't possible.\nThat blade is capable of so much. I think it will be the key to {i}all{/i} of that.
target: 如果灵能把力量从土地转移到一个人身上？\n那就没有理由认为反过来不可能。\n那把剑能做到的事太多了。我认为它会成为{i}这一切{/i}的关键。

source: Is there a library in Mazeo?\nLike, a place to read up on the spirits?\nI have some stuff I'd like to look into.
target: 马泽奥有图书馆吗？\n就是，能查阅关于灵的资料的地方？\n我有些东西想查一查。

source: Because the spirits have blessed us, right?
target: 因为灵保佑了我们，对吧？

source: I guess that's one popular theory.\nBut to be honest, I don't buy it.\nSpirits can't change our nature.
target: 这大概是一种流行的说法。\n但说实话，我不信。\n灵改变不了我们的本性。

source:
A1 - Mylus' Note
A2 - On Alestia's Creation
A3 - On Scribes and Visions
A4 - The True Reach of Spirits
target:
A1 - 迈勒斯的笔记
A2 - 论阿莱斯蒂亚的创世
A3 - 论书记官与预视
A4 - 灵的真正影响力

source: Go against the spirits, and you're seen as evil, or crazy.\nBut out here, that's normal. It allows people to get more creative.\nI've seen a bunch of new theories about our world, and the spirits.
target: 一旦违背灵，你就会被视为邪恶，或者疯子。\n但在这外面，那很正常。这让人能更有创造力。\n我看到了许多关于我们世界和灵的新理论。

source: And how would you explain Alarinthia, for that matter?\nWas it destined to always be an arid wasteland...?\nThe spirits {i}must{/i} have something to do with it.
target: 那阿拉林西亚又该怎么解释？\n它注定永远是一片干旱的荒地吗……？\n灵{i}一定{/i}和这有关。

source: But there's a part of me that hopes they're right.\nIf the spirits weren't keeping us warm? Then we're fine.\nNothing bad will happen to Valinorth at all, right...?
target: 但我心底其实希望他们是对的。\n如果灵并没有在为我们保暖？那我们就没事。\n瓦利诺斯根本不会出什么事，对吧……？

source: I can't believe I'd say something like that.\nAll my life, I've been raised to believe in the spirits.\nBut now, the best thing to do, is throw that belief away?
target: 真不敢相信我会说出这种话。\n我这一生，都被教导要信仰灵。\n可如今，最好的做法，竟是抛弃这份信仰？

source: You know, I used to come to this tree, and listen for the spirits.\nI thought that if I listened closely, they might talk to me, you know...?\nBut they didn't. And now I know what that silence truly meant.
target: 你知道，我以前常来这棵树，聆听灵的声音。\n我以为只要仔细听，它们也许会跟我说话，你懂吗……？\n但它们没有。现在我知道那份沉默真正意味着什么了。

source: Spirits know everybody else did.\nHeh. Look at me, still using superstition.\nThe spirits had no power over us — no divine plan.
target: 众灵作证，其他人都这么做过。\n呵。看看我，还在用这种迷信的说法。\n众灵对我们毫无掌控——不存在什么神圣的安排。

source: Nothing will get in my way. That includes you.\nSo if you'll excuse me, I'm going to explore the castle.\nSpirits know I need a few drinks after everything that happened.
target: 什么都挡不住我。包括你。\n所以请见谅，我要去逛逛城堡了。\n灵在上，经历了这一切，我需要喝几杯。

source: Without the heat from the spirits, it'd freeze over and die.\nI mean, we believed it — but right now, it doesn't make any sense.\nThe Spirit Realm was a prison, right? Nothing mystical or beneficial.
target: 没有灵带来的热量，它就会冻住、消亡。\n我是说，我们以前相信这个——但现在想想，根本说不通。\n灵界是个监狱，对吧？没什么神秘，也没什么好处。

source: At least, it'll make my leadership of Valinorth a lot easier.\nThe one major problem I had to take care of — completely eliminated.\nI couldn't ask for anything better. It's almost like one last gift from the spirits.
target: 至少，这会让我统领瓦利诺斯轻松许多。\n我必须处理的那个大问题——被彻底消除了。\n再好不过了。简直像是众灵最后的礼物。

source: At least, it'll make Valessa's job as Elder a lot easier.\nThe one major problem she had to take care of — completely eliminated.\nI know it's stupid to say this now, but it seems like one last gift from the spirits.
target: 至少，这会让瓦莱莎作为长老的工作轻松许多。\n她必须处理的那个大问题——被彻底消除了。\n我知道现在说这话很蠢，但它像是众灵最后的礼物。

source: But their tradition isn't steeped in the spirits like ours was.\nAt the end of the day, will they even care about any of this...?\nThey almost live a world away, untouched by our problems.
target: 但他们的传统不像我们那样浸润着灵。\n说到底，他们会在乎这些吗……？\n他们几乎生活在另一个世界，不受我们问题的波及。

source: We need to figure out how to save Valinorth.\nAfter the attack, we can rebuild from the ashes.\nBut I also want to solve our problem with the spirits.
target: 我们得想办法拯救瓦利诺斯。\n袭击之后，我们可以从灰烬中重建。\n但我也想解决我们与灵之间的问题。

source: Wait, is this like a job interview or something?\nI've never been very good at \"selling\" myself.\nFirst and foremost though, I'd reconnect with the spirits.
target: 等等，这算是在考校我吗？\n我一直不太擅长“推销”自己。\n不过首先，我会重新连接灵。

source: That way, Valinorth wouldn't freeze over.\nA lot of people forget it's the spirits that keep us warm.\nAfter that, I guess I'd focus on what to do with the people.
target: 这样，瓦利诺斯就不会冻住了。\n很多人忘了是灵让我们保持温暖。\n之后，我想我会专注于如何安置人民。

source: Because the spirits have blessed us, right?
target: 因为灵保佑了我们，对吧？

source: I guess that's one popular theory.\nBut to be honest, I don't buy it.\nSpirits can't change our nature.
target: 这大概是一种流行的说法。\n但说实话，我不信。\n灵改变不了我们的本性。

source: I can't believe we've lost our connection with the spirits.\nThere must be some way to get it back, right...?
target: 真不敢相信，我们失去了与众灵的联系。\n总有办法恢复的吧，对吧……？

source: We look at each other, and smile.{w}\nThere had to be a way to reconnect Valinorth with the spirits.{w}\nWe had a long journey ahead of us, and plenty of time to learn how.
target: 我们相视而笑。{w}\n一定有办法让瓦利诺斯重新与众灵相连。{w}\n前路漫长，我们有充足的时间去弄清楚。

source: I can't believe we've lost our connection with the spirits.\nThere must be some way to get it back, right...?
target: 真不敢相信，我们失去了与众灵的联系。\n总有办法恢复的吧，对吧……？

source: We look at each other, and smile.{w}\nThere had to be a way to reconnect Valinorth with the spirits.{w}\nWe had a long journey ahead of us, and plenty of time to learn how.
target: 我们相视而笑。{w}\n一定有办法让瓦利诺斯重新与众灵相连。{w}\n前路漫长，我们有充足的时间去弄清楚。

source: I have no idea, and I don't think we'll ever find out.\nIt must tap into a person's spirit before it enters the spirit realm.\nThat's the only non-physical part of us that could be considered energy.
target: 我毫无头绪，也不觉得我们会有弄明白的一天。\n它一定是在一个人的灵进入灵界之前将其抽取。\n那是我们身上唯一能被视作灵力的非物质部分。

source: I can understand a vision of Valinorth being attacked. But seeing me, and watching me die?\nWe've never even met. How is it possible to know what I look like, and how I act?\nI know the spirits give visions of the future, but that's so specific; and it won't happen.
target: 我能理解看到瓦利诺斯遭袭的幻象。但看到我，亲眼看着我死？\n我们甚至从未见过面。怎么可能知道我的长相和举止？\n我知道众灵会赐予未来的幻象，但那也太具体了；而且它不会发生。

source: There's no way he should be able to. I imagine even {i}you're{/i} having trouble.\nIt's not meant for just anybody to wield. You need an incredible spiritual connection.\nDamek might have a small one, but Sovy? A man like that has {i}no{/i} connection to the spirits.
target: 他绝不可能做到。我猜就连{i}你{/i}驾驭起来也很吃力。\n它不是随便什么人都能用的。你需要与众灵有非同寻常的联结。\n达梅克或许有一点，但索维？那样的人与众灵{i}毫无{/i}联结。

source: I agree. I made good time on my journey over here.\nWe'll still be on schedule, even if we stop to rest.\nSpirits know I need it after the long trek I just took.
target: 我同意。我这一路过来走得挺快。\n就算停下来休息，我们也不会误了日程。\n刚走完这么长的路，我确实需要休息，众灵作证。

source: I think I saw the mountain peaks on my way up here.\nI wonder why the spirits chose {i}this{/i} place to settle down.
target: 我上来的时候好像看到了那些山峰。\n我很好奇众灵为什么选了{i}这里{/i}定居。

source: But first things first — we need to reconnect with the spirits.\nThere's no point settling down on condemned land.\nWe'll have to ensure our future before we plan it out.
target: 但当务之急是——我们需要重新与众灵建立联系。\n在被诅咒的土地上安顿下来毫无意义。\n我们得先确保未来，再去规划它。

source: We can travel the world together, creating alliances!\nAfter we save Alestia, we can reconnect with the spirits, too!\nWe'll have a huge network of allies — ready to take on any challenge.
target: 我们可以一起周游世界，缔结同盟！\n等我们拯救了阿莱斯蒂亚，还能重新与众灵建立联系！\n我们将结成庞大的同盟——随时应对任何挑战。

source: Do you act in Alestia's best interests? Or in the spirits?\nUntil now, everyone in Valinorth assumed that the two aligned.\nBut things are changing. They're starting to make a push.
target: 你是为阿莱斯蒂亚的最大利益行事？还是为众灵？\n直到如今，瓦利诺斯所有人都以为二者是一致的。\n但情况在变。他们开始有所行动了。

source: You know what they say about death, right...?\nWhen we die, we go on to live in the realm of spirits.\nWith that logic, spiritual energy should be infinite.
target: 你知道关于死亡的传说吧……？\n我们死后，灵会在灵界继续存续。\n按这个逻辑，灵力本应无穷无尽。

target: {image=icons/651.png} “为什么灵要给我幻象？”

source: {image=icons/651.png} \"The rest of the world doesn't care for spirits?\"
target: {image=icons/651.png} “世上其他地方都不在意灵吗？”

source: {image=icons/651.png} \"When we die, I think our spirit is released. That's our life.\"
target: {image=icons/651.png} “我们死后，我想灵会被释放。那就是我们的生命。”

source: {image=icons/651.png} \"Don't other nations handle fine without spirits?\"
target: {image=icons/651.png} “其他国家没有灵不也过得好好的吗？”
